item.title: Attorney General Ellison sues two contractors for fraud; urges anyone defrauded by them to contact his office
item.description:
Publication Date: October 14, 2025

Two unlicensed contractors allegedly defrauded Minnesotans out of at least $1.6M; deceived consumers that they were licensed with the State when in fact the State had banned them

https://www.ag.state.mn.us/Office/Communications/2025/10/14_Contractors.asp
